capabilities.name: ESPN

connect.label: Your ESPN league link or id
connect.where: Open your league on fantasy.espn.com: the number after leagueId= in the address is the league id (4242 in the example). A public league works by its id alone; ESPN has no sign-in for other apps.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: ESPN's scoring items read into the projections' scoring; any item not priced is listed on the league card — as built, not verified on a live league yet

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: ESPN's lineup slots read as ours (OP as superflex, D/ST as DEF); IDP slots are left out and said so — as built, not verified on a live league yet

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: the schedule and each week's points from ESPN's matchups — as built, not verified on a live league yet

players.label: Players
players.words: ESPN ids matched to Sleeper's through nflverse's id table; a player with no match is listed by name and not valued — as built, not verified on a live league yet

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents are the players no team rosters; ESPN's waiver order and budget are not read — as built, not verified on a live league yet

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops and trades from ESPN's transactions — as built, not verified on a live league yet

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: D/ST as team defenses; draft picks and waiver budgets are not read — as built, not verified on a live league yet

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform, for the players matched to our ids — as built, not verified on a live league yet

capabilities.note: Unofficial: ESPN has no public API for fantasy leagues. isuckatfantasy reads what a public league shows anyone, read-only.
